zh.title: 【Mem0 深度拆解】知識圖譜輸了論文卻不說？AI Agent 長期記憶只要 4 個動作
zh.summary: 同一個團隊做了兩個版本,一個簡單、一個用知識圖譜。照理說複雜的那個應該比較強,結果四類問題裡它輸了兩類 —— 而論文對這件事,一句解釋都沒有。這集我們把 Mem0 的記憶管理拆開來看,它其實只有四個動作;最後再回頭看那個沒被解釋的結果,講講我自己的猜測。
bullets: 為什麼 AI Agent 會忘記事情,以及「把記憶體開大一點」為什麼治不好這個病
Mem0 的記憶管理只有四個動作,簡單到你聽完就能用在自己的專案上
這篇論文真正證明的東西,跟它標題宣稱的不太一樣
知識圖譜版本反而在 multi-hop 問題上輸了 —— 論文沒解釋,我講講我的猜測

en.title: [Deep Dive: Mem0] The Knowledge Graph Lost and the Paper Stayed Silent? Understanding AI Agent Long-Term Memory in Just 4 Operations
en.summary: One team, two versions: a simple one and one built on a knowledge graph. The complex one should have won. It lost two of four question types — and the paper never explains why. We take Mem0's memory management apart (it's only four operations), then come back to that unexplained result and I'll tell you what I think happened.
bullets: Why AI agents forget, and why "just use a bigger context window" doesn't fix it
Mem0's memory management is four operations — simple enough to use on your own project today
What the paper actually proves isn't quite what the title claims
The knowledge-graph version loses on multi-hop questions. The paper doesn't say why; I'll give you my guess
